Juv/frist winter north/west @ 8.10
Between kittiwake and little gull in size and flight style.
Distant but upper wing markings highly distinctive. White V on rear wing and forewing clearly brown 
Initially distant and light tricky but eventually came closer and light better to confirm that the upper wing pattern was true and not trick of light
Dark on tail also visible once it was closer

Est
